title: Verify ordinary European compact-cell bank reads
platforms: European ROM and Windows interpreter under Wine
changes: Verify managed reads of two compact-cell records during the ordinary IN-08 action-12 continuation. The focused replay uses the normal e311-d310 dataset and alters every bank byte in the managed cartridge backing.
validation: The initial 300-frame Wine probe vxoi35oy ended before the direct task. The extended trace pmry89cu observes the task-13 descriptor at frame 8081 and the two record readers from frames 8097 through 8265.

limitations: The retained snapshot ancestry, interior reference, indexed selectors, ordinary byte-mode scenes and translated guest dispatch remain open. Linux, USA, native Windows and performance work are deferred.
